name: compare_device_links
description: INSTEON ONLY. Fetches a device's live link table and NuCore's own replica of it, then compares them and returns a plain-text report of matches, mismatches, and anomalies. Use this instead of calling get_dev_links_table/get_iox_links_table separately and comparing them yourself. This drives the PLM's serial hardware directly, so it cannot run at the same time as get_dev_links_table/get_all_plm_links/quick_plm_sanity_check or a second call to itself -- if one of those is already in progress this returns an immediate {"error": ...} rather than waiting; just retry shortly. Params: device_id (the device's address).

device_id.description: The device's real id/address, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
